question: Why is the goddess celebrated as Khaḍginī in the three worlds?
premises: Even they fled as if from fear of death
She is renowned as Khaḍginī in the three worlds
inference: Her fearsome power causes foes to flee, making her celebrated as Khaḍginī throughout the three worlds
plain_english: They fled as if from fear of death itself; therefore she is celebrated in the three worlds as Khaḍginī.
